contracts.requirement: A permanently blocked reconcile cannot delay readiness, run status, or wave progress.
Emergency stop is durably admitted while bulk evidence is at capacity.
Disconnecting a long poll releases transport resources without losing command state.
Instrumented external-await authority is independent of ordered event append authority.
Advertised and admitted commands on every surface resolve through one executable registry.
Canonical and admitted legacy aliases share one authorization/schema/capability record; ambiguous aliases are refused.
Typed application errors preserve code, message, detail, field, retryability and action across surfaces.
Classified process death emits a DeathCertificate and automatically resumes/retries in the preserved worktree.
A phantom failure with a live exact session reattaches and never duplicates the attempt.
Retry exhaustion creates an attention-required outcome and no additional attempt.
Elapsed time alone cannot terminalize work.
Blocking input creates attention visible to an existing authorized subscription.
Unacknowledged attention is replayed after restart.
No sent message remains without a classified delivery fate.
Full replay and snapshot-plus-suffix replay have identical projection digests.
A crash before snapshot rename leaves the old authority; successful rename leaves the new authority.
Retention/reaping preserves live pins and reaps only terminal-pinned evidence.
Route readiness and dispatch use the same resolver.
Liveness and readiness predicates are separate.
A raw filesystem write outside the worker worktree/scope is refused before mutation.
A principal for run A cannot access run B.
Restart continuity preserves active identities, fences and subscription cursors.
Control transport names and decomposition boundaries are generated/behavioral rather than line-anchored.
Clean checkout installs, tests, packs, installs the produced archive into a fresh prefix and smokes advertised bins.
The shipped fault-injected workflow exercises command admission, notification, failure classification and retry without authority loss.
Comparative evaluation records verified success, interventions, wall time, tokens, cost, retries, stranded attention, integration defects and cleanup failures separately.

All existing operator-facing control capabilities are discoverable and invocable through both CLI and MCP without dropping native fleet/kernel controls or exposing worker-internal authority as an operator command.
Observation and monitoring capabilities have complete CLI/MCP catalogue, describe, invoke and bounded snapshot paths derived from existing transports.
Readiness, workers, route capability cards, provider state and convergence scheduler telemetry are available from both surfaces through existing production authorities.
Message, answer, feedback, steer, interrupt and receipt communication capabilities retain one existing authority across CLI and MCP.
Operator-facing Run, wave, member, task, workflow, plan, board, package, selection and integration management capabilities are reachable through both surfaces.

Operator-facing knowledge, scratchpad, context, REPL, board and package capabilities are discoverable and invocable through CLI and MCP while embedded worker primitives remain explicitly inventoried and scoped.
Debug, evidence, verification, readiness, route, provider, orientation and environment-awareness capabilities are unified without weakening their existing evidence or authorization class.
Attention, decision, message, watch, follow and notification systems are visible on both surfaces and may not silently rewind or collapse refusal into emptiness.
